title: Richard Thompson's Alien Identities on the Hindu devas

tellings.quote: Richard Thompson has written a great uh UFO uh book like looking very carefully at Hindu scriptures such as Ramayana and Mahabarata. I think it's called alien identities.

plain: The philosopher Jason Jorjani says a writer named Richard Thompson wrote a fine UFO book, which he thinks is called Alien Identities, that looks closely at the Ramayana and the Mahabharata, two ancient Hindu epics, and their gods, the devas, as possible accounts of visitors. Jorjani brings it up on the show from his own reading, alongside the work of a writer named Michael Cremo, author of Forbidden Archaeology.
